title: Moho layer tree
description: See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §6 and docs/moho-export-pipeline.md §2-3 for the full field-by-field evidence and the render-time decision order. Draw order (back to front) is simply the order layers appear in a `layers` array - nothing in the document is a z-order index.

LayerEffects.description: Per-layer image effects. All of them EXCEPT `visibility` are at their default/off values in every sample and are not applied; `visibility` is genuinely used (190 layers across 14 files) and IS applied - see its own description.

alpha.description: The layer's own OPACITY, keyframeable, from the General tab's Compositing Effects group. MEASURED as a plain linear blend: rendering a layer at 0.5 lands on the exact midpoint of its 1.0 and 0.0 renders (mean error 0.13/255). 139 LEAF layers across 15 of the 46 sample files set it to something other than 1, and 11 of those animate it; APPLIED by both exporters (SVG `opacity`, Lottie transform `o`). A CONTAINER's own alpha is NOT applied - three candidate models were measured and the best still scored worse than ignoring it, so moho2svg.py warns instead (5 layers corpus-wide). A layer faded to 0 also contributes nothing to a mask.

visibility.description: ANIMATED show/hide, and - the manual is explicit about this (ch. 12.02) - "totally independent of the visibility box displayed in the layer list": the list flag is an editing convenience, this one is what the render honours. A layer draws only when BOTH are true. Non-trivial on 190 layers across 14 of the 46 sample files; APPLIED by both exporters via Layer.visible_at. (An earlier revision of this schema recorded it as "true everywhere", which was a 19-file artefact.)

LayerOutline.description: An extra outline stroked around the whole layer's silhouette. Off in every sample.

LayerColor.description: A flat colour override for the whole layer. Off in every sample.

LayerShadow.description: Drop shadow. Off in every sample. Note: `threshold` here is a BOOL channel, not numeric, despite the name.

LayerShading.description: Inner shading. Off in every sample. Note: `threshold` here is a BOOL channel, not numeric.

PerspectiveShadow.description: Off in every sample. Note: `threshold` here is a BOOL channel, not numeric.

MotionBlur.description: Off in every sample; not meaningful for a flat single-frame export anyway. An older-generation variant omits extended_frames/frame_percentage/sub_frames.

Physics.description: 2D physics simulation parameters. Disabled in every sample; not applied by moho2svg.py.

Transforms.description: A layer's local transform. Rotation and scale pivot on the layer's own `origin`, not local (0,0). Only translation/scale (Vec3, though the z component is ignored by this 2D-only reverse-engineering)/rotation_z/flip_h/flip_v are applied by moho2svg.py; rotation_x/rotation_y (3D) and shear are read but never applied.

ActionRegistryEntry.description: An entry of a layer's own `actions` list - a document-wide action-NAME REGISTRY replicated on nearly every layer, not a per-layer list of that layer's own actions (confirmed: a BoneLayer with zero bones can carry the exact same action names as a 157-bone skeleton elsewhere in the same document). `pose` is always the literal integer 0 here - the REAL pose data lives on individual channels' own `actions[]` entries (see channel.schema.json ActionRef), keyed by the same `name`. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §11.

LayerCommon.description: Fields observed on every layer type regardless of `type`. Container-only fields (layers[], group_mask, expanded, skeleton, ...) are NOT here - see the per-type schemas below.

edit_only.description: Kept for editing convenience, never rendered - Moho's own SVG export defines an empty <g> for such a layer rather than drawing its shapes.

origin.description: Plain (not a channel) - the pivot point for `transforms`.

parent_bone.description: Index into the enclosing BoneLayer's skeleton.bones, or -1 for flexible ("region") binding across the whole skeleton (or flexi_bone_subset, if narrower). -1 is overwhelmingly the most common value. -3 has also been observed, exclusively on ImageLayer instances that also carry a non-trivial flexi_bone_subset - presumably a distinct binding mode specific to raster/bone-warped images; not decoded, and NOT handled by moho2svg.py (which only distinguishes -1 from >=0).

flexi_bone_subset.description: A "|"-joined list of BONE INDICES (not names), e.g. "1|2", restricting flexible binding to those bones. "" means all bones in the skeleton (or, per the -3 finding above, some other full-skeleton default). Distinct from mesh.groups' PointGroup, which names point indices, not bone indices.

masking.description: This layer's role within its parent's mask, when the parent container has group_mask active. An eight-value ENUM, one per entry of the manual's own Layer Masking menu (ch. 12.05), decoded twice over and in agreement - by the declaration order of MM_* in Moho's own scripting header, and independently by rendering every value with Moho itself (see docs/moho-project-file-format.md section 10 for the measurement tables). 0 = clipped to the mask AS IT STANDS at this point in the draw order; 1 = "don't mask this layer"; 2 = add this layer to the mask; 3 = subtract it; 4 = add it but keep the layer invisible; 5 = subtract it, keeping the layer invisible; 6 = clear the mask, then add this layer; 7 = clear, add, and keep it invisible. Every non-zero mode DRAWS UNCLIPPED (measured). The whole field is INERT when the container's group_mask is 0 - even the invisible modes do not hide the layer then (also measured). APPLIED in full by moho2svg.py via Exporter._mask_plan, which builds the mask incrementally rather than once per container.

blend_mode.description: How this layer composites against what is drawn beneath it: 0 = Normal, 1 = Multiply, 2 = Screen, 3 = Overlay, 4 = Add, 5 = Difference, 6 = Hue, 7 = Saturation, 8 = Color, 9 = Luminosity, 10 = Soft Light, 11 = Color Dodge, 12 = Color Burn, 13 = PSD Linear Dodge (Add). The manual names these modes but never numbers them; the ordering is the one the Moho 14.4 binary itself uses when it builds that menu. Distribution across the sample set: 0 on 3794 layers, 1 on 117, 2 on 49, 3 on 2 - so 1/2/3 are the only values with any evidence behind them, and they are confirmed by rendering (see moho2svg.py's own LAYER BLEND MODES section); 4-13 are NOT verified. Both exporters now apply this: moho2svg.py as a CSS mix-blend-mode plus isolation on the containing group, moho2lottie.py as a layer `bm` (which cannot reproduce the per-container isolation, since it flattens the tree).

quality_flags.description: A bit field of per-layer render toggles. Not decoded. Observed values include 4092, 4094, 45052, 45054, 2044.

camera_immune.description: Manual ch. 12.02, "Immune to camera movements": this layer ignores the document camera and stays put on screen while the camera moves - meant for backgrounds, titles and logos. True on 6 layers across 3 files. APPLIED by both exporters (the layer projects through the default camera instead), and inherited by descendants.

distortion_layer_uuid.description: UUID of another layer used as a distortion mesh - the most likely storage hook for Moho's Smart Warp feature. Empty in all 827 layers that carry the field; absent from the 1021 format generation. Now also matched at the MECHANISM level (not the serialization level - still not confirmed as the same field) by Moho's own scripting API, MohoLayer::SetWarpLayer(MohoLayer*)/GetWarpLayer() - a plain MeshLayer, marked via MarkAsWarpLayer(bool, target)/IsWarpLayer()/IsCurver(), pointing at the layer it deforms. Not read by moho2svg.py, which does not even warn about it. See docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md section 5 (5.1b for the API finding).

scale_compensation.description: How a layer's stroke width reacts to ancestor scaling.

timing_offset.description: Shifts this layer's whole timeline. Observed constant 0 in every sample - a non-zero value would desync the frame moho2svg.py evaluates, since it is not applied.

mask_expansion.description: Presumably grows/shrinks the mask edge. Observed false in every sample; not used by moho2svg.py.

LayerMetadata.description: Small per-layer key/value bag written by Moho's editor and by layer scripts. Observed on MeshLayer, BoneLayer and SwitchLayer instances. Purely editor bookkeeping - not read by moho2svg.py. Left open (additionalProperties) because the key set is tool/script dependent, but every key seen across the 19 sampled documents is enumerated below.

what.description: Observed constant 0. Meaning unknown - the same key appears in the document-level `metadata` bag.

NewLayerScript.description: Set by Moho's "new layer" script hook.

LM_GrandpaBones.description: Observed only on SwitchLayer instances (ReparentBone.animeproj). Presumably the same feature as BoneLayer.grandpa_bone.

psd_layers.description: A "|"-joined list of PSD layer indices, e.g. "24|12|7|23|...". Observed on the BoneLayer wrapping a PSD cutout-puppet import (BoneStrengthTool.animeproj), recording which PSD layers became ImageLayer children.

^g_[0-9]+$.description: Numbered editor toggles (g_10000, g_10001, g_10002, g_10031, g_10033, g_10056, g_10069, g_10082 observed). Not decoded.

ScriptData.description: Per-layer data written by a Moho layer script. Rare (2 BoneLayer instances, WhatIsBone.animeproj). Not read by moho2svg.py.

LayerContainer.description:
Fields shared by every layer type that HOLDS other layers (BoneLayer, GroupLayer, SwitchLayer). Kept separate from LayerCommon because a leaf layer (MeshLayer, ImageLayer, PatchLayer, TextLayer) never carries them. Note `depth_sort`/`distance_sort`/`layer_ordering`/`animated_layer_order` were observed on BoneLayer and GroupLayer only, never on SwitchLayer - they are declared here as optional rather than duplicated per type.

DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: the `layers` array itself. Reaching the recursive `$ref: Layer` through this extra `$ref` hop - inside an allOf, inside the recursive Layer oneOf - costs about 11x in wall-clock validation time (measured: SketchBone.animeproj 16.6s -> 182.8s) for exactly the same semantics. Each of the three container types therefore declares `layers` in its own branch. Do not "tidy" it in here.

group_mask.description: Whether this layer, as a mask CONTAINER, masks its children, and what the mask STARTS as (see LayerCommon.masking on the children). 0 = no masking in this group; 1 = "Reveal all", the mask starts FULL so every child is visible until something subtracts; 2 = "Hide all", the mask starts EMPTY (the common case). Measured against Moho's own renders and agreeing with the GROUP_MASK_* comment in Moho's own scripting header ("0=none, 1=all visible, 2=all invisible"). Observed: 0 in 42 files, 2 in 34, 1 in 4.

depth_sort.description: Sort children by depth instead of list order. Observed false everywhere; NOT implemented by moho2svg.py, which always uses list order.

distance_sort.description: Observed false everywhere; not implemented by moho2svg.py.

layer_ordering.description: An animated child draw-order override. Present on effectively every container (150 instances), but with an EMPTY string value in all of them - so no sampled document actually reorders its children over time. Not read by moho2svg.py: a document that does use it would export with the wrong stacking order.

animated_layer_order.description: Whether `layer_ordering` above is active. Observed true on exactly 2 containers across the sample set (ControlBones.animeproj, SketchBone.animeproj) - and even there the paired layer_ordering channel is empty.

extra_lines.description: Observed constant 0 except on a real minority of layers with extra_sketchy=true, where it is 5 - a confirmed, currently-visible output difference (repeated jittered strokes are not drawn).

squashable_deformer.description: Deformer flag, present only in the 1045 format generation (all 21 MeshLayers of the one 1045 document; absent from 1038 and 1021). false in every sample. Meaning not decoded - see docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md section 5.2.

triangulated.description: Deformer flag, 1045-only, false in every sample. A triangulated mesh is what a deformation mesh needs and a drawing mesh does not - see docs/moho-rigging-and-deformation.md section 5.2.

frame_zero_deformer.description: Deformer flag, 1045-only, true in every sample. Presumably 'this deformer is defined at frame 0', matching the rest-pose-at-frame-0 convention bones already use. Not decoded.

Mesh3DOptions.description: Settings for Moho's 3D-mesh-extrusion rendering of a MeshLayer, gated by the sibling `3d_mode` field. Present on EVERY sampled MeshLayer (648 instances across all three format generations, including the MeshLayer nested inside a TextLayer), always with identical default values, and always inert because `3d_mode` is 0 everywhere. Not read by moho2svg.py, which exports flat 2D geometry only - a document that actually enables 3d_mode would export without any extrusion or 3D shading.

3d_crease_angle.description: Radians. Observed constant 1.047198 (= pi/3, i.e. 60 degrees).

layers.description: Child layers, in draw order (back to front). Declared here rather than in LayerContainer for the performance reason documented there. NOTE: Moho's own Layer Pool panel lists children in the REVERSE of this order (topmost-drawn first) - the JSON order IS the draw order and needs no reversal.

grandpa_bone.description: Lets bones in this skeleton also bind layers nested deeper than its own direct children.

gravity.description: Bone-physics gravity. Rare - observed on exactly one BoneLayer across the whole sample set (Bandit.mohoproj, version 1045). Note the shape differs from GroupLayer's own `gravity` field in BOTH key names and value type: {direction,strength} as CHANNELS here, vs {x,y} as plain floats there. Not read by moho2svg.py.

direction.description: Angle in radians (observed 4.712389 = 3*pi/2, i.e. straight down).

wind.description: Bone-physics wind. Same rarity and same channel-wrapped value convention as `gravity` above. Not read by moho2svg.py.

layers.description: Child layers, in draw order (back to front). Declared here rather than in LayerContainer for the performance reason documented there.

gravity.description: Group-physics gravity as a plain 2D vector. Note the shape differs from BoneLayer's own `gravity` field in BOTH key names and value type: {x,y} as plain floats here, vs {direction,strength} as channels there. Observed on 16 GroupLayers across all three format generations (1021/1038/1045). Not read by moho2svg.py.

layers.description: The alternatives; exactly one is shown at a time, selected by switch_keys.

switch_keys.description: An animated string naming the currently-active CHILD LAYER NAME (not an index). The recorded name can go stale if that child was later renamed - moho2svg.py falls back to the first child, matching Moho's own behaviour.

skeleton.description: Present but with an empty bones list in every sample - do not mistake a SwitchLayer for a BoneLayer.

target_layer_uuid.description: Names another layer elsewhere in the document (in every sample, a sibling within the same group) whose mesh this patch reuses, redrawn at this patch's own draw-order position.

target_layer_id.description: Present alongside target_layer_uuid in every sample; observed values include 0, 1, 2, 3, 7. Purpose beyond the uuid is unknown.

PatchLayer.description: Carries NO `mesh` or `layers` field of its own in the raw JSON. moho2svg.py resolves it after the whole tree is built, copying the TARGET's mesh/transform/parent_bone/flexi_bone_subset/origin onto the patch (the patch's own transform is confirmed wrong to use - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §12) and drawing the target's FILL only, never its outline (confirmed against the Moho app).

text.description: The literal string; \n for line breaks.

fillcolor.description: PLAIN 0-255 integer colour (not a channel), unlike almost every other colour field in the format.

mesh_layer.description: The laid-out glyph outlines as a COMPLETE, ordinary MeshLayer - confirmed to carry the full MeshLayer field set (noise/sketchy fields, 3d_mode, 3d_options, texture paths and filerefs, ...), not just type+mesh. moho2svg.py synthesises it into a real child Layer at load time (named `<layer>_text` if it has no name of its own), after which nothing downstream special-cases TextLayer at all - the font/balloon fields above are then purely informational.

PlainRGBA.description: A plain (non-channel, non-animated) colour using 0-255 integer components - as opposed to the 0.0-1.0 float components used inside a ColorChannel.

ImageLayer.description: A raster image/movie/PSD-import layer. NOT covered by docs/moho-project-file-format.md (discovered only once a broader sample of Moho's own bundled tutorial documents was censused - e.g. BoneStrengthTool.animeproj's "dude side.psd" rig, one ImageLayer per PSD layer). NOT handled at all by moho2svg.py (a vector-only exporter) - a document using ImageLayer will silently lose that artwork on export. Participates in the same bone-deformation fields (parent_bone, flexi_bone_subset) as a MeshLayer, including the otherwise-unseen parent_bone==-3 value (see LayerCommon.parent_bone) - presumably Moho's bone-mesh-warp deformation for a raster image, distinct from a vector mesh's rigid/flexible binding, and not reverse-engineered.

avi_alpha.description: Whether an embedded movie's alpha channel is used.

psd_layer.description: Present on most, not all, sampled ImageLayer instances.

ParticleLayer.description: A container that animates its own sub-layers so they spray outward from its origin - water, fire, bubbles (manual ch. 11.11, and the Particles tab at 12.11). Rare but real: 2 instances, both nested inside Gathered-01Intro2/Gathered-02Wire2.mohoproj. Not rendered by either exporter, which emit an unsupported-layer warning. Property descriptions below quote the manual's own dialog labels.

layers.description: The sub-layers used as the particles themselves. Declared here rather than in LayerContainer for the same performance reason GroupLayer gives.

num_particles.description: "Particle Count" - how many particles are visible at once.

preview_particles.description: "Preview particles" - the smaller count drawn in the working view only.

particle_lifetime.description: "Lifetime (frames)" before a particle is recycled back to the source. Zero means they never recycle.

particle_activation.description: "On at start", and animatable: switching it off mid-animation stops NEW particles without killing the ones already alive.

source_shape.description: "Source width" / "Source height" / "Source depth" as x/y/z - a plain vector, not a channel. A non-zero z puts some particles nearer the camera than others. Spelled out here rather than $ref'd to project.schema.json's PlainVec3, to keep this file free of a reference back to the file that references it.

use_base_as_source.description: "Use Base Layer as Source" - emit from the bottommost sub-layer's shape instead of the source box.

velocity.description: "Velocity" - starting speed. The manual calibrates it: 2 crosses the screen vertically in one second.

start_dir.description: "Direction" to spray in, in RADIANS (observed 1.570796 = straight up).

start_spread.description: "Spread" - how wide the spray is, in radians (the manual quotes its maximum as 360 degrees = all directions).

accel_angle.description: "Acceleration" direction, in radians (observed 4.712389 = straight down, i.e. gravity).

start_full.description: "Full speed start" - begin already running rather than ramping up.

orient_particles.description: "Orient particles" - rotate each to face its direction of travel.

free_floating.description: "Free-floating". When FALSE the particles are tied to the layer and move with it.

evenly_spaced.description: "Evenly spaced" - release particles at even time increments.

random_start_time.description: "Randomize playback" - each particle starts its sub-layer animation at a random time instead of frame 0.

seed.description: RNG seed for the whole simulation. Not named in the manual; needed for a reproducible result.

NoteLayer.description: A comment pinned into the layer tree (manual ch. 11.12). Draws nothing in a render. 1 instance in the sample set. Not rendered by either exporter, which emit an unsupported-layer warning - correctly, since there is nothing to draw.

Layer.description: Any layer node, discriminated by its `type` field. Covers every type the 46-file sample set contains. The format defines one more, AudioLayer (manual appendix F.03, which lists every layer `type` string the format uses), which no sample document uses and which is therefore deliberately absent rather than guessed at.
